data.name: Foxalot: Steal Together
data.detailed_description:
Foxalot is an online action co-op game where you play as foxes to locate and steal physics-based loot.

Play solo or online with up to 5 of your friends to steal the most loot while fighting other foxes (bots, your friends, complete strangers!) and human enemies. Spend your gains on cosmetics, tools and weapons to crush rival team!

PHYSICS BASED FUN

Everything you interact has physics! Combine your tools to create fun and unexpected moments. Everything that moves can be tethered together, tied balloons to and be used as a cannon fodder to launch all across the map, including you, the foxes!

TOOLS AT YOUR DISPOSAL

Use Foamizer to carve paths and create unique ways to steal, place Zipline hop between buildings, deploy Cannon to launch cargo your teammates across the map. Be creative and mix all tools to sabotage your friends rival team!

RAGDOLLS AND PROXIMITY VOICE CHAT

Nothings funnier then your friends screaming voice slowly fading away as they rise to the sky with the balloons you attached.

data.short_description: An online co-op action game up to 6 players. Play as mischievous foxes to locate and steal fully physics-based loot while fighting humans and other rival foxes. Play solo, online with or against your friends!

Minimum:

  • Processor: Core i5 6600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
